subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be accepted as a core TUI config surface, a PluginStatusProvider/plugin API plus cached provider-usage bridge, or kept to existing `/usage` and `/status` surfaces?
rationale: The request crosses public config, possible Plugin SDK API, provider credential polling, and terminal rendering behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: API-First Footer Extension
options.body: Approve a narrow plugin/API-driven status contribution model and reuse bounded provider-usage summaries for cost, balance, and quota text after the rendering contract is settled.

options.title: Core Footer Template
options.body: Add a first-party `tui.footer` template/config surface, accepting the compatibility and config-surface cost in core.

options.title: Keep Existing Surfaces
options.body: Decline persistent TUI footer customization for now and keep `/status`, `/usage`, and external plugins as the supported visibility paths.

recommendation.title: API-First Footer Extension
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow plugin/API-driven status contribution model and reuse bounded provider-usage summaries for cost, balance, and quota text after the rendering contract is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: Current TUI footer/schema blame and provider-usage/status ownership make this the strongest available routing candidate for the product boundary choice.
